Class Customer

java.lang.Object
entity.Customer
Direct Known Subclasses:
CriticCustomer, RegularCustomer, VIPCustomer
public abstract class Customer extends Object
Customer who visits the restaurant, this tracks their satisfaction , id, and state.

    • recoverSatisfaction

      public void recoverSatisfaction(int points)
      Raises this customer's satisfaction by the given points, never going above MAX_SATISFACTION. Used by Happy Hour (Stage 3), when customers still waiting for a table or food recover 15 at turn start.
      Parameters:
      points - how much satisfaction to recover, e.g. 15

    • chooseItem

      public MenuItem chooseItem(Menu menu)
      Chooses this customer's dish from the menu using a fixed rule, so runs can be reproduced: customer n orders item (n - 1) mod the menu size. With the standard menu, customer 1 orders Salad, customer 2 Burger, customer 3 Pasta, customer 4 Salad again, and so on.
      Parameters:
      menu - the menu to choose from
      Returns:
      the menu item this customer orders
